verdict.rationale: Firestore/Realtime Database are NoSQL document/JSON stores with only chained filtering (firebase-docs-2), no relational joins, foreign-key constraints, or multi-document ACID transactions across relations exposed as a query language; community feedback explicitly notes lack of server-side query power and no business logic/schema enforcement layer (firebase-comm-4, firebase-comm-15, firebase-comm-16). No evidence of join/constraint/relational transaction support.
